Frequently asked questions

What is Pet Nova?

Pet Nova is an app that helps you care for your pet's health and safety: medical history, vaccine reminders, Paw Alert and a map of pet-friendly services.

Can I register more than one pet?

Yes. Pet Nova supports multiple pets per account, each with its own profile.

What is Paw Alert?

Paw Alert lets you post a lost pet alert with a photo and GPS location, and the community can help with the "I saw it" button.

Which languages does the website support?

English, Spanish, German and Portuguese. Use the globe button in the menu to switch.

How can I contact the team?

Write to petnovitas2027@gmail.com or visit the Contact page.
